description: This file defines data structures for app notification messages, subscription requests, and status responses within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes classes for representing notification payloads, subscription filters, and status messages, utilizing JSON serialization.

classes.name: NotificationMessage
classes.description: Represents an application-originated notification with fields for app ID, type, title, body, timestamp, data, and priority.

classes.name: SubscriptionRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to subscribe to notifications filtered by app ID and optional types.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Represents a generic status response indicating success or failure with an associated message.

methods.name: NotificationMessage()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON container and adding notification fields.

methods.name: SubscriptionRequest()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON container and adding subscription request fields.

methods.name: StatusResponse()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON container and adding status response fields.
